_help: Events Claude adds by hand (OVE Facebook Events tab, local event lists). Down-the-canyon events are included on purpose: the Valley has few bars, venues, classes or rinks, so Valley people go to Ogden for them. start/end are local times with offset (-06:00 until Nov 1, -07:00 after). into: ov or weber. Past events drop off on their own. Weekly regulars use "weekly": {"days": ["MO","WE"], "time": "20:30", "hours": 3.5, "from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "until": "YYYY-MM-DD" (optional)} instead of start/end, and repeat on their own for the next 60 days.
